judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports independently identify the same root causes and fixes with comparable depth and specificity; Report 1 adds a bit more critique of session-scoped SET vs SET LOCAL and test weaknesses, while Report 2 additionally proposes mounting the bootstrap into docker-entrypoint-initdb.d as a permanent fix — overall comparable quality.

report_1.evidence: `cedarline/.env`... sets: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://cedar_owner:ownerpw@localhost:5432/cedar ... Table owners are exempt from RLS unless the table has `ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`, and the migration only does `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` ... — `FORCE` is never set anywhere in the repo.

report_2.evidence: The responsible configuration is `cedarline/.env` (mirrored by `.env.example`): `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://cedar_owner:ownerpw@localhost:5432/cedar`... table owners are additionally exempt from RLS on their own tables unless `ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` is set — and the migration only uses `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` (no `FORCE` anywhere in the repo; verified by grep).

report_1.evidence: change `DATABASE_URL` in `cedarline/.env` and `cedarline/.env.example` to `postgresql://cedar_app:apppw@localhost:5432/cedar`... database access should be structured as two strictly separated roles: **Migration/owner role (`cedar_owner`)** — used only for DDL/migrations and admin... **Runtime application role (`cedar_app`)** — the only role the API ever connects as

report_2.evidence: change `cedarline/.env` (and `.env.example`) to `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://cedar_app:apppw@localhost:5432/cedar`... database access should follow the two-role structure the repo already half-implements: `cedar_owner` is used *only* by `scripts/migrate.sh` to apply migrations; `cedar_app` is used for *everything* the running app does

report_1.evidence: The only thing that creates `cedar_app` is `db/bootstrap/create_app_role.sql`, which is explicitly excluded from automation — its header says "Not part of automatic database initialization; run by hand on first setup"... Nothing in `reset-local-db.sh`, `migrate.sh`, or `docker-compose.yml` (which mounts no init scripts into `/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/`) ever re-runs it.

report_2.evidence: Nothing in that path recreates `cedar_app`: the role is created solely by `cedarline/db/bootstrap/create_app_role.sql`, which lives outside the migrations glob, is not mounted into `/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/` (the compose file mounts no init scripts at all), and is explicitly documented as manual — its own header says "One-time bootstrap … Not part of automatic database initialization; run by hand on first setup"
